what: Destination-staging transfer for za-cct-substation-evening-peak-exceedance: copy the five accepted za-cct-001 artifact files (artifact 9f2e10ce485635f6, digests equal to the package MANIFEST.json) from private staging release 432591871 into the private dataset repository earino/za-cct-substation-evening-peak-exceedance draft release 434422204 (v2026.11), under the flat asset names the download helper restores. Each asset is verified against its recorded sha256 on arrival and against the server's own digest after upload; peak worker disk is one asset (8.4 MB total), so the bytes never pass through the coordinator. Asset ids were resolved by digest match through publish-dataset.py --stream-test, not hand-copied.
